title: What Changed? · A local procedure review desk
text: When a reference document changes, which checklist steps deserve another look? This app connects the edits to the procedure you maintain.

title: 1 · Bring the documents and your checklist
text: This shipping policy is synthetic. Each [section heading] connects a checklist step to a source section. Unanchored steps use shared-word matching.

title: A procedure you can reuse
text: Save the checklist in this browser for the next revision. Documents and review decisions stay in the tab. No API, account or model download is needed.

title: 2 · A deadline worth reviewing
text: The dispatch cutoff moved from 3 p.m. to 1 p.m. Exact passages and line numbers sit side by side. The highlighted text changed; you decide whether the step should.

title: Keep unchanged evidence in view
text: The returns passage still says 5 business days. “Text unchanged” describes this passage only. It does not certify that the checklist instruction is correct.

title: Missing evidence stays uncertain
text: The archive passage is missing from the new version. The app does not invent a replacement rule or conclude that retention is no longer required.

title: Misleading wording needs a human
text: The 24-to-12-hour edit is explicitly an example, not a commitment. The app flags uncertainty instead of telling staff to promise a faster replacement.

title: 3 · Record a decision with the evidence
text: A person marks “Revise step” and records what to check. Export includes both documents, exact passages, uncertainty reasons and human review notes.

title: A useful companion to a text diff
text: The raw diff also shows title and brand-copy edits unrelated to these steps. The procedure view organizes a review; it does not replace reading the full source.

title: The limits are part of the product
text: This uses anchors and lexical matching, not semantic AI. Cross-references and subtle hypothetical wording can be missed. A 12-case diagnostic set matched 10 expectations, with 2 misses disclosed.

title: Evidence before assumptions
text: What Changed? helps procedure owners see what to inspect, keep uncertainty visible and leave with a review they can explain. Built locally with the Devpost Learn Skill Pack.
